Name: BarleyZP's Allergies Cornucopia Compatibility
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/main/BzpAllergies/docs/screenshots/contentpacks/CornucopiaBanner.png[/img][center]

[size=4][b]This is a content pack for BarleyZP's Allergy Mod,[/b] a Stardew Valley mod which allows players to configure food allergies for an extra challenge. This pack makes the mod compatible with the items added in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]﻿﻿.
It is compatible with version 1.6+.[/size][/center][size=4][u]Content

[/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3]7 new allergies based on the items in Cornucopia: Almonds, Cashews, Peanuts, Pecans, Pistachios, Soy, and Walnuts[/size]
[*][size=3]Assigns any relevant Cornucopia items to the allergens in the base mod for full compatibility[/size]
[/list]﻿
[size=4][u]Installation
[/u][/size][size=3]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install this mod[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21238]BarleyZP's Allergies[/url], the mod that this mod is a content pack for[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]﻿, the mod that this content pack brings compatibility to[/size]

[*][size=3]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=3]Configure some allergies and enjoy the challenge![/size]
[/list]
